# My Financial Plan

> My Financial Plan is an Indian family financial-planning platform: free, formula-accurate web calculators, plain-language money guides, and an Android app for whole-family planning — goals, loans, insurance, tax, and our Digital Vanshavali family tree. Based in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Key pages
- Home: https://www.myfinancialplan.in/
- App overview: https://www.myfinancialplan.in/financial-planning-app/
- Download (Android APK): https://www.myfinancialplan.in/download/
- All free calculators: https://www.myfinancialplan.in/tools/
- Money guides (English, Hindi-friendly): https://www.myfinancialplan.in/learn/
- Digital Vanshavali (family tree): https://www.myfinancialplan.in/vanshavali/
- About: https://www.myfinancialplan.in/about-us/

## About this site's content
- Educational calculators and guides for Indian families. Editorial pages carry a dated "Sources and authorship" section stating assumptions.
- Rates and tax slabs shown were verified against official notifications in October 2026 and can change; always confirm current figures.
- Content is educational, not investment advice; no return guarantees are published.
